info.prompt: A cyber-gothic throne room where the player's neon-magenta throne levitates above hexagonal tiles pulsing with void echoes, its skeletal gold armrests branching into neural lattices that thrum with each BANK—streak meter climbing through WARM (orange veins), HOT (crackling magenta), FRENZY (white-hot corona), the entire chamber shuddering with screen shake as the 2.0× multiplier badge fractures the air with crystalline reverb trails.
